note: Old check-ins without a believable time and members saved before batches existed must still read
A member's own QR check-in in the app must show in the register with the tag 'App', and the desk's check-in must show on the other device
Under 5 register days gives the start words; a plan that ends inside the renewals window drops the member; fewer than 4 visits means no own rhythm and the fixed 12 days are used
A check-in near midnight must land on the India day; days-since-visit and the 8 week window move at midnight
Check in has a busy state per member; two desks checking in one member must leave one row
Reasons and labels are built in English inside the logic file; a Hinglish panel may show them untranslated
